subject.title: fix(approval): distinguish policy vs non-persistable reason when Allow Always unavailable

question: Should this PR remain the canonical fix while the contributor rebases it, rather than switching to the incomplete newer candidate?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but GitHub cannot merge the current head and multiple candidate PRs target the same issue; a maintainer must choose the landing branch before duplicate cleanup.

options.title: Keep this as canonical
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase this complete, proven branch, validate the exact head, then land it and close the duplicate candidates.

options.title: Adopt a replacement
options.body: Choose another candidate only after it reaches equivalent cross-surface coverage, generated i18n synchronization, clean mergeability, and real behavior proof.
